pains.label: 02 / Why clients come
pains.title: Clients usually come to us when something doesn't add up.

items.quote: “We do marketing, but there's no system.”
items.answer: Channels run on their own and aren't tied to a business goal. We start with an audit and connect them into one system.

items.quote: “We spend on ads but don't understand the economics.”
items.answer: We calculate the cost of a lead and a customer for every channel and move budget to where it pays back.
We define how you are different and why customers should choose you — and carry it into the brand and communications.

items.quote: “Leads come in and get lost in sales.”
items.answer: We build the path from lead to deal: CRM, scripts, automatic qualification and response-time control.
We map processes, introduce metrics and assign ownership, so growth no longer depends on the founder alone.

items.quote: “We want to enter a new market or win tenders.”
items.answer: We assess the opportunities, prepare the documents and manage participation — legal side included.

items.a: With a diagnosis of the business, market, product, processes and data. Then we define the core, design the system, implement it, measure results and scale.
Product, audience, positioning, value, differentiation, offer, key message and brand DNA. Until these decisions are made, ads, the website, content and CRM pull in different directions.

items.q: How is integrated marketing different from a set of services?
items.a: Brand, content, digital, advertising, sales, CRM, AI and analytics are designed as one system around one business goal — not bought separately from different vendors.
Wherever it strengthens a process that is already in place: lead handling, qualification, follow-ups, reporting and integrations. Process and data first, automation second.

items.q: Can we start with just one service?
items.a: Yes. You can start with an audit, a tender or automating a single process. Other practices join when they make sense.

sections.p: The data controller is CYBER MOVE CONSULTING ("we"). For any questions about your data, message us on WhatsApp at the number shown on this website.
Only what you provide in the request form or in your message: name, company name, contact details and a description of your task.
To reply to your request, discuss your task and prepare a proposal. We don't use your data for mailings without your consent and never sell it to third parties.

When you send the form via WhatsApp, the message is delivered by WhatsApp under its own terms. If the form is sent by email, the data travels over a secure connection and is stored in our work mailbox.
As long as needed to work on your request, or until you ask us to delete it.
You can ask what data we hold about you, and have it corrected or deleted. Message us and we'll respond within a reasonable time.
This website does not use advertising cookies or third-party analytics.
